file.description: Absolute path to the generated audio file

primary.name: mcode-tools
primary.notes: Cloud-hosted MiniMax TTS via mcode-tools CLI. Returns node_id + file_name; SDK downloads the asset to the local output path.

fallbacks.name: local-sapi-tts
fallbacks.notes: Windows System.Speech.Synthesis (SAPI). No network, no API key. Slightly lower quality but ships with Windows.

fallbacks.name: local-silent
fallbacks.notes: Silent WAV header. Last-ditch so the contract is still satisfied when both mcode-tools and SAPI are unavailable.
